I have gathered all the relevant information. Here is my report.

## Telephone Handling in the PetClinic-OfficeFloor Repository

### 1. Overview of files that deal with telephone/phone

- Entity/field: `src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/Owner.java`
- Base class (no telephone): `src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/Person.java`
- Validation + normalization (create): `src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/ValidateOwnerFields.java`
- Duplicate detection: `src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/EnsureTelephoneUnique.java`
- Update validation (no telephone normalization/uniqueness): `src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/ValidateOwner.java`
- Field copy: `src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/ApplyOwner.java`, `BuildOwner.java`
- Escalations: `.../rest/escalation/InvalidTelephoneException.java`, `InvalidTelephoneExceptionHandler.java`, `DuplicateTelephoneException.java`, `DuplicateTelephoneExceptionHandler.java`
- OpenAPI schema (source of the generated `OwnerFieldsDto`): `src/main/resources/openapi.yml` (`OwnerFields.telephone`)
- OfficeFloor YAML: `src/main/resources/officefloor/rest/api/owners.POST.yml`, `.../owners/{ownerId}.PUT.yml`, and escalation YAMLs `.../escalation/...InvalidTelephoneException.yml`, `.../escalation/...DuplicateTelephoneException.yml`
- Tests: `src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/AcceptanceTest.java`, `AcceptanceBase.java`
- JDBC SQL referencing the `telephone` column: `JdbcOwnerRepositoryImpl.java`, `JdbcPetRepositoryImpl.java`, `JdbcVisitRepositoryImpl.java`

Note: There is no hand-written `OwnerFieldsDto.java` / `OwnerDto.java` in `src`; these DTOs are generated from `openapi.yml` into the build output (`org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.dto`). To change validation constraints on the DTO you edit the OpenAPI schema, not a source file.

### 2. The Owner entity telephone field

`src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/Owner.java` (lines 47-51, plus getter/setter 78-84):

```java
    @Column(name = "telephone")
    @NotEmpty
    @Digits(fraction = 0, integer = 10)
    @Pattern(regexp = "^[0-9]{10}$", message = "Phone number must be exactly 10 digits")
    private String telephone;
```

```java
    public String getTelephone() {
        return this.telephone;
    }

    public void setTelephone(String telephone) {
        this.telephone = telephone;
    }
```

`Person.java` (base `@MappedSuperclass`) has only `firstName`/`lastName` — no telephone field.

### 3. Normalization ("10-digit number") and duplicate-detection logic

Normalization to 10 bare digits — `ValidateOwnerFields.java` (lines 35-39), runs first on `POST /api/owners`:

```java
        String telephone = request.getTelephone().replaceAll("\\D", "");
        if (telephone.length() != 10) {
            throw new InvalidTelephoneException(request.getTelephone());
        }
        request.setTelephone(telephone);
```

Duplicate detection — `EnsureTelephoneUnique.java` (entire class), runs next:

```java
public class EnsureTelephoneUnique {

    public void service(@Val OwnerFieldsDto request, OwnerRepository ownerRepository)
            throws DuplicateTelephoneException {
        String telephone = normalize(request.getTelephone());
        for (Owner existing : ownerRepository.findAll()) {
            if (telephone.equals(normalize(existing.getTelephone()))) {
                throw new DuplicateTelephoneException(request.getTelephone());
            }
        }
    }

    private static String normalize(String value) {
        return value == null ? "" : value.replaceAll("\\D", "");
    }
}
```

Duplicate detection is an in-memory `findAll()` loop comparing digit-stripped values; there is no DB-level `findByTelephone` query. It only runs on create (POST), not on update (PUT).

### 4. Tests referencing telephone

`src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/AcceptanceTest.java` — this is the active spec driving the desired change (header comment `telephone-e164`). Full contents:

- `coreNationalToE164`: posts `"0412 345 678"`, expects stored `$.telephone` == `"+61412345678"`.
- `functionalityKeepsExplicitCountryCode`: posts `"+64 21 123 456"`, expects `"+6421123456"`.
- `errorRejectsUnformattable`: posts `"12"`, expects 400.

These expectations conflict with the current 10-bare-digit normalization (`ValidateOwnerFields`) and the `Owner` entity `@Pattern("^[0-9]{10}$")` — the code currently produces digit-only strings, not E.164.

`src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/AcceptanceBase.java` (lines 98-104) — helper generating a valid AU-mobile-style 10-digit number:

```java
    protected String uniqueTelephone() {
        return String.format("04%08d", seq());
    }
```

Used by `ownerNode()` (line 123) as the default valid payload; `fillCity()` (line 173) relies on distinct telephones per owner.

### 5. OfficeFloor YAML endpoint + escalation files

Create flow — `src/main/resources/officefloor/rest/api/owners.POST.yml`:

```yaml

  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidateOwnerFields
  next: ensureUniqueTelephone

ensureUniqueTelephone:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EnsureTelephoneUnique
  govern: [ transaction ]

```
(then `build` → `save` → `respond`)
